description: Somos un equipo de ingenieros México - Chilenos que se conocieron en otro hackathon. Nos apasiona desarrollar videojuegos y el espacio exterior. Estamos muy felices de ser parte, estamos preparados para esta misión y nos encantaría conocer nuevas mentes brillantes.
summary: Houston, we are the problem. It's a video game built specifically to play with friends and company. It's a multiplayer game where you can play with at least 4 players; one of them is the NASA base with the instructions and communications with the other players, speaking on how the other players should solve the puzzles that they are describing to the base. Meanwhile, the rest of the players are in the International Space Station solving problems that happen in the moment; they have to solve them or they explode. If the time runs out, they will crash on earth, and they will be capable of repairing themselves or failing in the try, we have 2 versions one is in the repositories of github and the other one is a link to play.
details: A multiplayer video game designed to encourage teamwork and collaboration. Players take on the role of astronauts who must complete missions involving astronomy, space navigation, and physical exercise. The game incorporates real-world data provided by NASA to create an immersive and educational experience. A unique opportunity to learn, explore, and work together while discovering the challenges of life in space.
